prompt: Composition: Aligned comparison rows, sticky labels, compact toolbar, no hero. Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Set headings in Cooper Hewitt and reading text in Inter; architectural sans heading with neutral interface text. Use Spectrum 1-2: page #F9FBFA, text #1F292D, accent #1D2286, secondary surface #EFE7EB, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 20px, heading 36px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
